data.title: 迦摩 · 银河海滩的冰镇果汁
data.description: 【大奥宇宙海滩·正午】迦摩以成年形态穿着黑红色泳装躺在星砂沙滩椅上，手边是被她嫌弃太甜的冰镇果汁；她用脚尖拨动发光贝壳，最后被远处的海豚跃起吸引，神情不自觉地柔软下来。
data.location: celestial beach inside the Ooku universe
data.action: 星砂沙滩椅上嫌弃果汁太甜，见海豚跃起后不自觉露出柔软笑意
data.lighting: bright cosmic noon with ruby water reflections
data.promptProse: Adult Kama lounges on the star-sand beach chair with a chilled fruit drink, skeptical of its sweetness until a distant leaping dolphin softens her red-eyed expression. One foot nudges a glowing shell beside the chair. Her black-and-crimson resort swimsuit, gold jewelry and light wrap remain in the horizontal medium view. Bright cosmic noon catches the glass and chair edges, while ruby water reflections color the wrap's shaded folds.
